set.name: Faction Wars (also called the Beta Set / Base set)
set.theme: Champions grouped by League of Legends factions and races (origins such as Noble, Imperial, Demon, Yordle, Void, Pirate, Wild, Robot) plus combat classes.
set.nameNote: Riot never gave Set 1 an official subtitle at launch. CDragon calls it "Base"; the wiki calls it the Beta Set and lists "Faction Wars" as a conjectural name.

notes.itemScope: Items come from the patch 9.21 CDragon file. Legacy entries left in that file from earlier sets were dropped: where two items share a recipe, the one with this set's icon tag was kept; disabled items (negative ids) and internal placeholders were dropped.
notes.abilityValues: Computed with 100 AP and no items; star order 1/2/3. Unresolved placeholders listed per ability.
notes.augmentTiers: Inferred from icon art suffix or apiName; approximate.

mechanics: Core loop introduced: 8 players, shared champion pool, 5-card shop, buy XP, combine three copies into a higher star level, auto-battle against one opponent per round. [wiki]
Shared draft (carousel) at the start and then every 6 rounds; lowest-health players pick first; first carousel lets all 8 pick at once. [wiki Carousel]
Items: 8 components plus Spatula; two components combine into a completed item. Spatula items grant a trait. [CDragon]
PvE rounds (minions, Krugs, wolves, raptors, dragon/herald) drop loot orbs with gold, champions, or items. [wiki Gold]
Pirate trait (Gangplank, Graves, Pyke, Twisted Fate) dropped gold after combat. [wiki Gold]
Board was 3 rows of 7 hexes per side (changed to 4 rows in 9.22). [9.22 notes]
systemChanges: Income: 5 gold passive per round, +1 per 10 gold held (max +5), win/loss streak bonus. Exact Set 1 streak breakpoints: unknown. [wiki Gold]
Champion pool per champion at end of Set 1: tier 1 = 39, tier 2 = 26, tier 3 = 18, tier 4 = 13, tier 5 = 10. [9.22 notes, "before" values]
Level 8 shop odds at end of Set 1: 15/20/35/22/8% (tier 1-5). Other levels: unknown. [9.22 notes]
Player damage per stage at end of Set 1: 3/3/3/4/5/6 base. [9.22 notes]
Mana per attack at end of Set 1: 6-10 for 1-star, 10 for 2-star and 3-star. [9.22 notes]
XP: 4 gold buys 4 XP; 2 XP per round. [wiki Experience]
Mystery Box loot system added in 9.18. [wiki Gold]
